Theme

Latin word

aequus

aequus, aequa, aequum

adjective, declension

equal, even; level; fair; fair, just, impartial; fair, impartial; fair, reasonable, right

In this lexicon

  • equal

    also used · classical · Caes. B.G. 1.43.1: aequum ferē spatium; Cic. Off. 1.30: quod dubitēs aequum sit an inīquum

  • fair

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Verr. 2.4.65: praetor aequus et sapiens (Lewis & Short: “fair, equitable, impartial”); Traupman 146, 152, 154; Traupman 195

  • impartial

    the recommended word · classical · Lewis & Short: “of persons, fair, equitable, impartial”: praetor aequus et sapiēns (Cic.); Traupman 331

  • reasonable

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 152: fair, fair-minded; Ter. Eun. 3.2.25: quae līberum scīre aequom est adulēscentem (Lewis & Short); Cic. Imp. Pomp. 47: sīcut aequum est; Traupman 312
